hero.prob_take: The crowd is pricing a Hormuz shipping agreement at 1-in-4 odds, implying they expect either a breakthrough or status quo through end of November, but the 10-point spike in 24 hours suggests nervous money buying the rumor of actual talks. hero_trending.question: Will 1 Fed rate hike happen in 2026?
